title: Payment Retry Schedule and Hold Limit for Tailwise Autoship
content:
When the card on a Tailwise Autoship subscription is declined for a scheduled shipment, the billing team's retry schedule and hold limit depend on the program.

| Program | Automatic retries after the first decline | Calendar days between retries | Calendar days on payment hold before automatic cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | 2 | 1 | 14 |
| Autoship Custom Meal Plan | 2 | 1 | 14 |
| Autoship Pharmacy | 3 | 2 | 30 |
| Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | 2 | 1 | 21 |

The retry count is the number of automatic payment retries after the first decline on a scheduled shipment; the interval is the calendar days between those retries; the hold limit is the calendar days a subscription may stay on payment hold before it is cancelled automatically.

### Example retry calendar (hypothetical first decline on day 0)

| Program | Retry days | Last retry |
|---|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | day 2, day 4, day 6 | day 6 |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | day 1, day 2 | day 2 |
| Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | day 1, day 2 | day 2 |
